import java.util.*;
public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int INF = 0x7f7f7f7f;
    static int n, m, s, t, p, c, d;
    static int[] x = new int[505], y = new int[505];
    static int totalFlow, totalCost;
    static int edgeIdx = 1;
    static int[] head = new int[5000005], nextEdge = new int[10000010], toNode = new int[10000010], capacity = new int[10000010], costEdge = new int[10000010];
    static int[] dist = new int[5000005], parent = new int[5000005], lastEdge = new int[5000005], flow = new int[5000005];
    static boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[5000005];

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
        nextEdge[++edgeIdx] = head[u];
        toNode[edgeIdx] = v;
        capacity[edgeIdx] = cap;
        costEdge[edgeIdx] = cst;
        head[u] = edgeIdx;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(inQueue, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        inQueue[s] = true;
        dist[s] = 0;
        flow[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        parent[t] = -1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQueue[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = nextEdge[i]) {
                if (capacity[i] > 0 && dist[toNode[i]] > dist[u] + costEdge[i]) {
                    dist[toNode[i]] = dist[u] + costEdge[i];
                    parent[toNode[i]] = u;
                    lastEdge[toNode[i]] = i;
                    flow[toNode[i]] = Math.min(flow[u], capacity[i]);
                    if (!inQueue[toNode[i]]) {
                        inQueue[toNode[i]] = true;
                        q.offer(toNode[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return parent[t] != -1;
    }

    static void minCostFlow() {
        totalFlow = 0;
        totalCost = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            int current = t;
            totalFlow += flow[t];
            totalCost += flow[t] * dist[t];
            while (current != s) {
                capacity[lastEdge[current]] -= flow[t];
                capacity[lastEdge[current] ^ 1] += flow[t];
                current = parent[current];
            }
        }
    }

    static int nodeId(int layer, int node) {
        return layer * n + node;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();
        s = 0;
        t = n * 99 + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
            int xVal = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(s, nodeId(0, xVal), 1, 0);
            addEdge(nodeId(0, xVal), s, 0, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            x[i] = sc.nextInt();
            y[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 99; i++) {
            addEdge(nodeId(i, 1), nodeId(i + 1, 1), INF, 0);
            addEdge(nodeId(i + 1, 1), nodeId(i, 1), 0, 0);
            for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
                addEdge(nodeId(i, j), nodeId(i + 1, j), INF, c);
                addEdge(nodeId(i + 1, j), nodeId(i, j), 0, -c);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= p; k++) {
                    int cst = d * k * k - d * (k - 1) * (k - 1) + c;
                    addEdge(nodeId(i, x[j]), nodeId(i + 1, y[j]), 1, cst);
                    addEdge(nodeId(i + 1, y[j]), nodeId(i, x[j]), 0, -cst);
                    addEdge(nodeId(i, y[j]), nodeId(i + 1, x[j]), 1, cst);
                    addEdge(nodeId(i + 1, x[j]), nodeId(i, y[j]), 0, -cst);
                }
            }
        }
        minCostFlow();
        System.out.println(totalCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
